text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: hosted-usw3 GPU pool saturation detected — admission_control rejections spiking. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood.company/hosted/usw3/pools?range=5m :rotating_light:

alex: Looking at the dashboard now — queue length ~1.8k, p95 latency jumped from 1.2s -> 3.4s over the last 10m. admission_denied ~22%.

priya: Confirmed on metrics ingest. rate_limit tokens are hitting the admission threshold. Also higher model-inflight counts for gpt-medium-q4.

ben: Autoscaler logs show failed scale-ups with quota errors:
```
2026-03-18T13:12:02Z autoscaler ERROR scale-up request rejected: quota exceeded: Requested GPUs 10 > quota 8
```
This explains why capacity didn't recover.

lina: If it's a quota problem, manual node adds will also fail. We should consider immediate traffic routing + model fallback while infra sorts quotas.

alex: Short-term plan suggestion:
1) Reroute low-priority/PLG traffic -> euw1 (up to 30%)
2) Lower admission thresholds for enterprise/tiered customers to preserve SLAs
3) Temporarily reduce batch_size / max_tokens per request to shrink GPU slot usage
4) Request cloud quota bump for GPUs

priya: I can implement the routing policy for non-SLA requests. Will route at the gateway for calls with `x-redwood-tier: free|plg`. Latency impact for non-SLA should be acceptable.

ben: euw1 currently p95 ~220ms for embeddings and ~340ms for gen for the same model, so it's viable for non-SLA routing. I'll open the quota request with cloud and link the ticket here.

lina: Also flagging potential networking flakiness between control plane and provisioning endpoints — I see intermittent API timeouts in the node provisioner logs from last hour. Could delay scale-ups. Ben, can you confirm?

ben: Yup, node-provisioner logs show repeated 504s to cloud-provider API around 13:05-13:10. Sample:
```
ERROR provisioning: failed to create instance: cloud-api timeout (504) retrying
```
I'll correlate with cloud provider status page.

lina: Ops-cost note: temporary reroute + fallback scale will add cost, rough estimate +$4.5k/day if sustained. Prefer quota bump to avoid sustained spend.

alex: I'm going to reduce default batch_max_tokens for hosted-usw3 gpt-medium-q4 from 1024 -> 512 to reduce per-request GPU footprint. Will roll to canary first.

priya: Config change rolled to canary for 10% of traffic. Monitoring: admission_denied down to ~12% in canary slice after 5m.

ben: Filing autoscaler controller PR — found bug where pending pod counts are ignored when node state == 'provisioning'. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/autoscaler/pull/432

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-054. Paged @infra-oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-054

alex: Summary / action items:
- priya: implement reroute up to 30% non-SLA -> euw1 (in progress)
- alex: reduce batch_max_tokens (done to canary)
- ben: open quota request + autoscaler PR (in progress)
- lina: investigate node-provisioner networking timeouts and cloud provider alerts
- ops-bot: track incident and page if status regresses

priya: I'll post updates every 10m in this thread. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigation in progress. Next update scheduled at 1865432160.
